mechanics.title: Suitability ranking
mechanics.description: Compares your current height with each ore's best detected height and lists them in order, optionally showing a percentage. The percentage is not an absolute spawn chance.

mechanics.title: Customizing the list
mechanics.description: Add any registered block via the config screen (search by name or registry ID). Selected blocks stay visible even below the minimum suitability. Other options: HUD position, icons, UI scale, animated reordering, update interval, max entries.

qol: Quick check of the best Y level for each ore while mining
getting_started: The HUD is off by default in this pack (config/oreheightindicator.json has hudEnabled false). Open the mod's config (via Mod Menu), turn it on, then move the HUD, pick which blocks are shown and set the minimum suitability.
editor_notes: The pack ships config/oreheightindicator.json with hudEnabled false. No default keybind is known. How it determines the best height (worldgen data vs. built-in) was not verified.
name: Ore Height Indicator
summary: A compact HUD overlay that ranks ores (and any extra blocks you add) by how suitable your current height is for finding them.
sources: facts/mods/ore-height-indicator.json (config strings only; no description page in facts)
